description: This file defines the interface for ProxyResolutionService, a component responsible for determining appropriate proxy servers for URL requests within the Chromium project. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and references to related classes and external files.

classes.name: net::ProxyResolutionService
classes.description: An interface class that provides methods for resolving proxies for URL requests, reporting success, managing proxy cache, and handling shutdown procedures.

methods.name: ResolveProxy
methods.description: Determines the appropriate proxy for a given URL and request method, returning a status code or indicating pending resolution.

methods.name: ReportSuccess
methods.description: Reports a successful proxy connection, updating proxy retry information.

methods.name: SetProxyDelegate
methods.description: Associates a delegate with the proxy resolution service.

methods.name: OnShutdown
methods.description: Prepares the service for shutdown by canceling requests and preventing new ones.

methods.name: MarkProxiesAsBadUntil
methods.description: Marks specified proxies as bad until a certain time, optionally adding additional bad proxies.

methods.name: ClearBadProxiesCache
methods.description: Clears the cache of bad proxies.

methods.name: proxy_retry_info
methods.description: Returns the map of proxies marked as bad.

methods.name: GetProxyNetLogValues
methods.description: Provides debug information related to proxy resolution for logging.

methods.name: CastToConfiguredProxyResolutionService
methods.description: Checks if the instance is of a specific implementation type and casts it accordingly.
